name: czl-deskforge
description: Turns one colloquial sentence of need into a working single-file HTML workbench that opens offline in any browser. A request is first compressed into a scope card (at most four blocks, each with a stated input, a stated display and a stated judgement), then modelled as a data ledger (named fields, namespaced storage keys, seed rows, export/import path), then assembled from five card primitives — list, matrix, form, metric and time — so any scene is composed from parameters instead of a fixed module catalogue. Layout keeps a 'due today' strip on top, seeds three to five sample rows including one overdue, and stays readable on a 375-pixel-wide phone with 44-pixel hit targets and 16-pixel inputs. Everything is inlined: no CDN, no font hosting, no chart library, no icon font, charts and icons hand-written as SVG. Ships three standard-library checkers — a compliance lint for external references, emoji-as-icon, input sizing, storage prefixes and file weight; a DOM prober for missing element ids, undefined handlers and cyclic render calls; and a scope-card generator that refuses more than four blocks — and nothing is released until both checkers report zero errors. Use for building a personal dashboard, habit tracker, study log, ledger, project board or family check-in page that must keep working with the network off.

displayDescription.en: One sentence in, one offline-capable single-file workbench out: four blocks, a due-today strip, exportable data, zero external links, with a factory check before delivery.
displayDescription.zh: 把一句话需求装配成能直接用的单文件工作台：四块模块、今日置顶、数据可导出，零外链，附出厂体检。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Build me a study log workbench: record daily questions done and wrong ones, count down to the exam, and show a fortnight trend. Put the due-today block on top.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 给我搭一个备考打卡台：每天记刷题量和错题，倒计时到考前，再看最近两周的趋势。今天要做的放最上面。

quickPrompts.en: I want a household ledger I actually keep using: quick expense entry, monthly budget ring, category breakdown, and a one-tap export so I never lose the data.
quickPrompts.zh: 想要一个我能坚持用的记账台：快速记一笔支出、月度预算进度环、分类占比，再给我一键导出，别让我把账弄丢。

quickPrompts.en: Here is a workbench you built earlier — run the factory check on it and tell me what a phone would break on.
quickPrompts.zh: 这是上次搭的工作台，跑一遍出厂体检，告诉我手机上哪里会出问题。
